claims.object_text: mTOR hyperactivation, altered mTOR-associated gene expression

claims.object_text: rapamycin (RAPA) partially rescues phenotypes in animal models
claims.quote: Similarly, the mTOR inhibitor rapamycin (RAPA) only partially rescues phenotypes induced by loss of DEPDC5 in animal models, suggesting some pathological mechanisms independent of mTOR.

claims.quote: These effects were partially (up to 33% of genes) attenuated by RAPA treatment applying a clinically comparable concentration.
